What is the contraction of "they are"?
The contraction of "they are" is "they're".

Describe the principle of the Law of Supply.
The Law of Supply states that as the price of a product or service increases, the quantity supplied to the market also increases, as producers are incentivized by the increased profit potential. Likewise, as the price of a product or service decreases, the quantity supplied to the market also decreases due to decreased profit potential.

What is the purpose of Financial Accounting?
The purpose of financial accounting is to provide relevant and accurate information to help entities make informed decisions and effectively manage their finances. It also provides a reliable record of their financial transactions, which is essential to conducting business.

Give a definition of "algae".
Algae are a large and diverse group of simple, typically autotrophic organisms, ranging from unicellular to multicellular forms. They range in size from microscopic to large seaweeds and are classified in the same kingdom as plants, although unlike plants they lack true roots, stems, and leaves. Algae typically live in moist environments, including marine, freshwater, and terrestrial systems.

Explain the purpose of hypertext markup language (HTML).
Hypertext Markup Language (HTML) is a language used for creating web pages and applications. It is used to structure and present content for the web, including text, images, videos, and other forms of content. HTML is used to describe the structure of a web page, such as headings, paragraphs, lists, and links. It also describes how the content should be displayed on the web page.

Generate a list of fashion trends for Spring 2021.
Spring 2021 fashion trends include bright colors, tie-dye and other prints, polka dots, pastels, boho style, flared jeans and trousers, utilitarian looks, earthy tones, sustainable fabrics, and cropped tops.

Identify a programming language suitable for game development.
C++ is a suitable programming language for game development, as it is a high-performance language that can handle complex calculations. Furthermore, it has good support for object-oriented programming and memory management, making it well-suited for creating sophisticated game engine features such as AI and physics simulation.

5. Print perimeter 
6. End

Describe the sound of a train passing by.
The sound of a train passing by is a low, rumbling sound that gradually grows in intensity as it approaches and fades away slowly as it moves further away. It is often accompanied by a sharp whistle that cuts through the air like a blade.

Write a definition for the term "machine learning".
Machine learning is an application of artificial intelligence that gives systems the capability to automatically learn and improve from experience without being explicitly programmed. This process of machine learning involves data mining techniques to predict outcomes, identify patterns, and classify data without the need to explicitly define rules.

Provide an example of a metric that could be used to measure the success of a new marketing campaign.
A metric that can be used to measure the performance of a new marketing campaign is the number of leads generated, which is a measure of the number of people who take action (e.g. opting into the email list or signing up for a product trial). This metric will help to quantify the success of the marketing campaign in terms of the desired outcome.

Generate two interesting facts about potatoes.
One interesting fact about potatoes is that they are the most widely grown vegetable in the world. The second interesting fact is that sweet potatoes are not genetically related to potatoes and are actually members of the morning glory family.

Select the correct answer: what is the difference between a class and an object?
A class is a blueprint that can be used to create objects which have their own characteristics and behaviors according to the class definition. An object is an instance of a class and has properties and methods that belong to that class.

Define ‘Exploratory Data Analysis’.
Exploratory Data Analysis is an approach to analyzing data which involves discovering patterns and relationships in the data without making any assumptions beforehand. It usually involves visualizing the data to uncover patterns which can then be used to make meaningful conclusions about the data.

Search the web for the most common symptoms of the flu.
The most common symptoms of the flu include fever, headache, muscle aches and pains, fatigue, congestion, runny nose, and coughing. Less common symptoms can include a sore throat, nausea, vomiting and diarrhea.
